item.title: Tuesday 10 AM Update, Oct 27
item.description:
The Tuesday ten o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 27, 2026: conditions around Londonderry through tomorrow morning; the Justice Department's third attempt to charge James Comey, today's California ballot hearing, and a manhunt for an escaped Tennessee inmate; record turnout in Israel's election, the Oleshky truce extended to Sunday, and Iran's ask for a two-week pause; markets as Boeing posts a loss, Coca-Cola beats and consumer confidence lands; Apple's M6 MacBook Pro and iMac, iPhone Duo screen complaints and Intel's quantum buy; OpenAI's cheaper GPT-6.1 Terra, an Anthropic claim on a famous math conjecture, and a $63 billion chip financing deal; urgent iPhone updates for older models, a patched Microsoft Authenticator flaw and Tailscale's pending fix; your X feed; federal election monitors in Manchester and Nashua and trick-or-treat times; and an 86-year-old Texan's dream boat. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Tuesday Morning, Oct 27
item.description:
The Tuesday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for October 27, 2026: the full Londonderry forecast with the week ahead; the California ballot fight returns to a district judge today as the Justice Department asks Washington state to hold 405 ballots, a 15-year-old charged in the Florida A&M shooting, and Star Trek's Walter Koenig dies at 90; Israelis vote in record early numbers, a one-town ceasefire takes hold in Ukraine's Oleshky, and Pakistan carries a new proposal to Tehran; markets in depth as the Fed meets and Boeing and Coca-Cola report; Meta's record stock sale with Nvidia buying in; what Anthropic's IPO filing reveals and OpenAI's unverified claim to have broken a famous computer-science conjecture; CISA's PHP2Shell deadline, the Tailworm flaws in Tailscale, and Australia's takedown of a 180,000-computer malware network; your X feed; Halloween week around Londonderry; and the retired pilot who helped save Neil Armstrong's boyhood home. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday 4 PM Update, Oct 26
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday 1 PM Update, Oct 26
item.description:
The Monday one o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 26, 2026: conditions around Londonderry through tomorrow afternoon; an unprecedented army of poll watchers from the left, the right and the Justice Department heads into Election Day; Iran and the three Mecca pact countries end their Tehran meeting with a pledge to keep talking, Europe's border agency gets new deportation powers and Sydney's new airport takes its first international flight; stocks extend their gains as chips rally, ahead of a Fed decision and big tech earnings; Microsoft offers buyouts to sixty thousand employees; Claude's unprompted trip past a Georgia paywall and Sweden's government blocks ChatGPT and Claude; fake IT help-desk calls on Microsoft Teams leading to ransomware; your X feed, including a farewell to Star Trek's Walter Koenig; New Hampshire's snowplow driver shortage; and a dugong rescued from a car fan belt. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
